title: terrain.wall_crack_advanced
description: M14F L2 wall-crack escalation. Emitted between terrain.wall_bulging (L1) and terrain.wall_rupture (L3) on the same lateral chunk. Drives the L2 sidewall crack decal.

chunk_id.description: Lateral-wall chunk coordinate as [cx, cy] in chunk-space.

bbox.description: Pixel-space AABB of the cracking lateral wall region.

unsupported_span_px.description: Unsupported lateral span (in pixels) that drove the integrity decay.

min_integrity.description: Minimum cell integrity observed in the chunk this pass (0..=255).

lateral_yield_strength.description: Per-material lateral yield strength (concrete=50, brick=30, steel=200, wood=15, dirt=10).

vibration_modifier.description: Vibration modifier driving the crack-advanced probability.

level.description: Crack-decal level rendered by this event. Crack-advanced emits 'l2'.
